_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Instructional Media Design Package
summary: Provides the preparation instructions for the Instructional Media Design Package, which documents the design of courseware, including course content, lesson strategy, and courseware logic flow, for the development and production of training materials.
use_relationship:
The Instructional Media Design Package provides the design documentation for the development and production of courseware.

a. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the preparation instructions for the content and format of the Instructional Media Design Package.

b. This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the performance requirements described by 3.2.4 of MIL-PRF-29612B, and is applicable to the acquisition of training data products. Data product performance evaluation criteria are specified in 4.3.4 and 4.3.9 of MIL-PRF-29612B.

c. It is not intended that all the requirements contained herein be applied to every program or program phase. Portions of this DID are subject to deletion tailoring depending upon the program phase in which it is applied in the contract. Any individual data requirement contained in this DID is subject to deletion tailoring.

d. This DID supersedes DI-ILSS-81520A.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The format of data contained within this DID is as follows:

children.title: Page-based products, for which contractor format is acceptable
Standard digital data in compliance with the content
children.content: Standard digital data in compliance with the content and format requirements specified in the DoD Data Architecture (DDA) and the Defense Data Dictionary System (DDDS).

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Instructional Media Design Package shall contain the following:

children.title: Front matter
children.content: The content of front matter shall be in accordance with Appendix A of MIL-PRF-29612B.

children.title: Summary description of training
children.content: The training summary shall provide a brief description of training materials being developed. The summary shall include:

children.title: Training program title, identifier, and version identifier
A brief description of the major topics
Number of instructional hours training materials will be
children.content: Number of instructional hours training materials will be used.

children.title: A listing of the methodologies employed in the
children.content: A listing of the methodologies employed in the design, development, implementation, and presentation of the training program.

children.title: A listing of the equipment being simulated in
children.content: A listing of the equipment being simulated in the training program.

children.title: Location of the training sites
Location of the administrative repository for the reports
children.content: Location of the administrative repository for the reports and evaluation materials to include necessary points of contact, addresses, and telephone number(s).

children.title: Keyword listing
A description of the target audience to include
children.content: A description of the target audience to include occupational specialty and skill level.

children.title: Operational equipment designator and nomenclature covered by the
children.content: Operational equipment designator and nomenclature covered by the training program.

children.title: Associated course(s) title and identification number
Developmental software product name(s), version, vendor name, and
children.content: Developmental software product name(s), version, vendor name, and Government rights code.

children.title: Operating system name, version, and additional software drivers
children.content: Operating system name, version, and additional software drivers required to operate the training program.

children.title: Portability standards name and version identifier
Delivery system requirements description to include minimum free
children.content: Delivery system requirements description to include minimum free system memory, central processing unit type and speed, minimum hard drive storage space, number of disc drives and types, graphics adapter type, and input and output devices.

children.title: Security requirements code
Security classification code and restrictions to distribution code
Courseware design strategy
children.content: This data shall provide descriptions of elements required to design the courseware. The data shall also include over-teaching, integrated and isolated practices, front loading, prerequisite skills, combined task practices, media features, branching strategies, learning events, ratio of drill and practice, degree of simulation, and frequency of testing. The required elements shall include:

children.title: Conventions
children.content: This data shall identify the techniques, practices, principles, or procedures to be used throughout the design and presentation of the module or lesson. Conventions shall define the use of text (e.g., font size, type, color, background, placement), menus, warnings, cautions, procedures, tests, screen direction, placement of cues, touch areas, keys or other input devices, motion, stills, image source, audio configuration, and narration.

children.title: Course title and description
children.content: This data shall provide the title(s) and a brief description of the course(s).

children.title: Course task data
children.content: The data shall identify the specific tasks being supported and shall include the following:

children.title: Specific tasks
children.content: The data shall identify all tasks to be supported by the course and courseware. This information shall be provided as a narrative list and will provide the logical delivery sequence of the course and shall be consecutively numbered.

children.title: Estimated time to complete
children.content: The data shall provide an estimated time required for an average trainee to complete each course component.

children.title: Recommendations
children.content: This data shall include the identification of specific technical requirements and source material to enhance the design effort.

children.title: References
children.content: This data shall include the complete title and number of all reference materials used in course or courseware design.

children.title: Safety, hazard, or environmental considerations
children.content: This data shall include all safety, hazard, or environmental considerations.

children.title: Interface design and controls
children.content: This data shall describe interfaces and controls which support the input and pacing of trainee performance. The data to be provided shall include descriptions of the following:

children.title: Practice, remediation or branching as controlled by the
children.content: Practice, remediation or branching as controlled by the trainee or system instructor.

children.title: Trainee practices (i.e., independent or practice including team
children.content: Trainee practices (i.e., independent or practice including team interaction).

children.title: How the system shall be able to vary
children.content: How the system shall be able to vary presentation rate to individual trainee ability.

children.title: How the system shall be able to vary
children.content: How the system shall be able to vary the sequence and range of presentation based on trainee ability.

children.title: How the system shall allow the instructor to
children.content: How the system shall allow the instructor to provide input during training or effect the individual or group performance pace and path.

children.title: How the portability commands and interface mechanisms supporting
children.content: How the portability commands and interface mechanisms supporting interface and controls shall be identified.

children.title: Test design strategy
children.content: This data shall provide a description of test scenarios, applying test items, presentation sequence, appropriate learning types and levels, frequency, student interface, remediation options, and performance tracking.

children.title: Abnormal operating conditions to be simulated
children.content: This data shall provide a description of abnormal operating condition(s) which could affect accomplishment of performance standards.

children.title: Course overview
children.content: This data shall identify each module or lesson of an instructional unit, and the recommended presentation sequence for all modules or lessons, and any interrelationships.

children.title: Course schedule
children.content: This data shall include a chart showing the course's daily and weekly schedule, learning objectives, enabling learning objectives, knowledge, skills, attitudes, instructional events, and media selected.

children.title: Performance tracking control features for instructional media
children.content: This data shall identify all course control and instructional media control features, their interrelationships, and their respective rationale. It shall include the following performance tracking and support features:

children.title: Trainee data to be collected, (e.g., name, rank,
children.content: Trainee data to be collected, (e.g., name, rank, social security number, job position, training requirement, address).

children.title: Tracking of individual trainee progress through a course,
children.content: Tracking of individual trainee progress through a course, (e.g., problem flags, time on task, use of help functions, comments, repetition, etc.).

children.title: Listing of individual and aggregate test scores and
children.content: Listing of individual and aggregate test scores and times.

children.title: Analysis of test items response branching
Courseware routing (allows for entry, re-entry and instructor
children.content: Courseware routing (allows for entry, re-entry and instructor intervention).

children.title: Record of courseware and hardware usage by
Student
Instructor
Support personnel
Schedule of trainees, equipment, ranges, and other resources
Inventory of course materials (e.g., expendables, ordnance, fuels)
A description of all management reports to be
children.content: A description of all management reports to be generated for supervisors and trainees.

children.title: Course Structure Format (CSF)
children.content: A description of the CSF hierarchy to include sub-structure, sequencing, global properties, Sharable Content Objects (SCO), external references, and metadata tagging conventions reflect capability for operating and course using the specific Learning Management Systems (LMS).

children.title: Lesson strategy
children.content: The lesson strategies shall contain the following:

children.title: Organization and format
children.content: This data shall describe the organization and format of the lesson and segment strategies. It shall list the headers or section designators that are used, explain the meaning of each designator, and describe the type of information that is found under each. A key shall be used to explain the symbology. This explanation shall be supported with one or more illustrative examples. The lesson strategy shall exhibit traceability to the courseware development process and shall include:

children.title: A reference number, a unit number, and lesson
children.content: A reference number, a unit number, and lesson number referenced from the syllabus.

children.title: A short title description of the subject to
children.content: A short title description of the subject to be covered. The title shall be taken from the syllabus lesson title.

children.title: A description of the media for each lesson
A list of Learning Objectives (LOs) covered by
children.content: A list of Learning Objectives (LOs) covered by each medium.

children.title: A brief overview of the content of the
children.content: A brief overview of the content of the lesson shall be provided for lesson authors, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and students. The overview shall also include an explanation of why the lesson is required, how it is related to previous lessons, and how the lesson fits into the total program.

children.title: Learning objectives
children.content: The LOs shall describe the type and level of learning required for each LO. Each LO shall have two numbers assigned: (1) a sequence number to indicate its order of presentation and (2) an identification number to indicate its rank in the LO hierarchy.

children.title: Unit and lesson maps
children.content: The unit map shall contain a flow diagram showing the sequences and relationships among lessons in the instructional unit. The lesson map shall include a flow diagram showing the hierarchical relationships among lesson objectives.

children.title: Lesson design strategy
children.content: The lesson design strategies shall describe decision-making processes and strategies to be used in designing and implementing the presentation of material and testing student mastery of subject matter. Specific strategies shall include an instructional strategy for each lesson-learning phase, methods of interaction, procedures which assure testing at appropriate learning types and levels, and remediation. Segments to be tested shall be identified and the method of testing defined. (Specific emphasis should be placed on the design strategy for developing and implementing the instructional media into the training program and equipment.) Training, learning, and branching strategies shall also be included, when required. All strategies used shall be appropriately labeled and sequenced under the title description. The lesson design strategy shall identify the conventional techniques, practices, principles, or procedures to be used throughout the design and development of the instructional media module or lesson. The following information shall also be provided:

children.title: A statement of what type behavior the student
children.content: A statement of what type behavior the student must exhibit in order to master the LO.

children.title: The facts to be memorized, the critical attributes
children.content: The facts to be memorized, the critical attributes of a concept, the steps to follow in applying a rule or procedure, or the cause and effect relationship of a principle. Aids shall be included in the instructional content to help the student recall. The strategies data shall list the most common errors made by the student when learning.

children.title: A description of instance production and shall include
children.content: A description of instance production and shall include each type of scenario that is to be included in the examples, practice, and test items. A table shall be provided listing the total number of examples, practice and test items that the lesson author must produce for each type of scenario.

children.title: A description of the theoretical basis upon which
children.content: A description of the theoretical basis upon which each instructional strategy is employed.

children.title: A description of SCO specifications and metadata tagging
children.content: A description of SCO specifications and metadata tagging requirements necessary to support courseware object interoperability across platforms and systems, reusability, and Internet protocol compatibility.

children.title: A description of the level of granularity for
children.content: A description of the level of granularity for the SCO to be applied within the lesson and the rationale for the level of granularity applied.

children.title: A list of the metadata tags required for
children.content: A list of the metadata tags required for each SCO in final deliverable format (i.e., compressed or uncompressed) as an element of the course or lesson.

children.title: A list of the metadata tags required for
children.content: A list of the metadata tags required for each original uncompressed format media object.

children.title: Test items
children.content: The test items shall include the type of test and the approach for feedback and remediation based on the lesson design strategy. A list of the test items to be used in measuring the student's knowledge shall be provided and include a statement of the minimum acceptable passing criteria for the lesson or segment. A list of examples and practice exercises to be used in support of the instruction shall also be provided.

children.title: Lesson format guide
children.content: The lesson format guide shall contain explanations of how each section of the lesson and segment specifications will be used during lesson authoring. Special instructions or additional information shall be provided to ensure accurate communication of the content for authors and artists. It shall contain a description of the following:

children.title: Text and graphic layout conventions
Interpretation of lesson strategies
Data sources for expansion of lesson strategies
Learning strategy guidelines
Use of symbology
Titling
Figure numbering
Referencing conventions
Page numbering
Prototype lesson
children.content: The prototype lesson shall consist of courseware, to include supporting design and developmental documentation. (This prototype will demonstrate how the format guide is to be used in conjunction with a lesson strategy to produce the required lessons.)

children.title: Instructional media resource requirements
children.content: The data shall contain a summary of required resources to include:

children.title: An estimate of the visual and audio resources needed
children.content: An estimate of the visual and audio resources needed to support the course as follows:

children.title: Existing and new resource footage (e.g., video, audio,
children.content: Existing and new resource footage (e.g., video, audio, film, slides, photographs, graphics, artwork).

children.title: Support requirements (e.g., props, equipment, SMEs, military and
children.content: Support requirements (e.g., props, equipment, SMEs, military and civilian personnel).

children.title: Talent
Field environment, (e.g., ranges, ships)
Studio requirement
Special equipment
Costumes and uniforms
Lighting
Animation rationale, source, and extent of usage
A list of the material to be presented
children.content: A list of the material to be presented during the course.

children.title: A list of any adjunctive materials required to
children.content: A list of any adjunctive materials required to support the course.

children.title: A description of the types of personnel and
children.content: A description of the types of personnel and their respective roles and responsibilities for lesson development.

children.title: Courseware logic flow diagrams
children.content: Courseware logic flow diagrams shall include all defined lesson tasks with references, information frame or sequence, decision points, branching options, remediation, and other screen activities. All flow diagram symbols used shall be clearly defined. Flow diagrams shall include:

children.title: All blocks of instruction and decision points
All program paths or branches
Video, graphics, and text frames with reference and
children.content: Video, graphics, and text frames with reference and sequence numbers.

children.title: Audio, still frame, and other audio configurations with
children.content: Audio, still frame, and other audio configurations with reference and sequence numbers.

children.title: Performance decision notes
Processing and design decision information that supports the
children.content: Processing and design decision information that supports the remediation, non-scored test items, motion sequences, computer processing, performance update, scored test items, scoring routine, and database search commands to be used.

children.title: A legend identifying key symbols that connect elements
children.content: A legend identifying key symbols that connect elements of the flow diagram.

preparation_instructions.title: Standard digital data
preparation_instructions.content: Standard digital data shall be delivered for the Standard Data Elements (SDEs) marked with an "X" in the "Required" box in Table 1.
